sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was meaningfully raised: the first full-year 2026 capex guide was disclosed at $115B to $135B, nearly double 2025, but operating income is still guided above 2025, which reassures on the line that mattered most. The revenue landed near the top of the guide and free cash flow stayed strong, indicating organic momentum. The score is +0.5 because guidance was raised materially (capex and operating income outlook) and the feared numbers arrived with reassurance attached, not because of backward-looking beats.

summary.revenue: $58.9B, up 25% year over year, near the top of the guide. Family of Apps ad revenue $58.1B, up 24%. Reality Labs $955M, down 12%.
summary.guidance: Q1 2026 revenue guided to $53.5B to $56.5B with a 4% currency tailwind. First full-year 2026 guides: expenses $162B to $169B and capex $115B to $135B, nearly double 2025. Operating income still guided above 2025 despite the spend.
key_risks: Legal and regulatory headwinds in the EU and US, with trials scheduled this year that may result in a material loss.
Reality Labs losses expected to stay near 2025 levels before improving.
Currency tailwinds fade later in 2026 and EU ad changes may bite.
key_opportunities: Sales of glasses more than tripled last year.
WhatsApp paid messaging crossed $2 billion annual run rate.
30% increase in output per engineer since the start of 2025.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management described a 'major AI acceleration' and guided operating income above 2025 despite massive capex, indicating confidence in the forward outlook.
